mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Harriet Park under a full moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight's low will be 50 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The city is moving forward with the 2027 budget planning process. Additionally, the Plan Commission is set to meet November 4th to discuss various items, including final plats for Ardent Glen and site plans for 1979 Milky Way.

It is a busy weekend for local fun with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Tomorrow, you can catch yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by a week full of trivia and the Main Street Trick or Treat event this Wednesday.
On October 15, the Verona Police Department responded to a report of dangerous driving and arrested a school bus driver for operating a vehicle while impaired.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl. The store is currently open until 10 PM, so head on over to grab a scoop before they close for the night.
